summary: Iter 22 — Full backend+frontend test of the Estimate Approval workflow (send-for-approval, public no-login approve/reject with single-use 14-day tokens, manual admin override, auto-open ProjectFormModal pre-filled from estimate, link-project, re-send-after-reject, audit events). Created /app/backend/tests/test_iter22_estimate_approval.py (14 pytest cases, 14/14 pass in 13.9s) covering: wrong-token 403, reuse 410 (POST + GET), public view/reject-with-reason, resend invalidates old token + resets state, manual decision RBAC (Client/Vendor 403, Accountant 200), invalid action 422, link-project 422 when not approved / when already linked, send-approval 422 when linked, link-project 404 missing project, link-project RBAC Accountant 403, and audit events endpoint returns actor-attributed log. Regression: test_iter21_estimates.py 22/22 pass. Frontend Playwright ran 20 flows on Admin session — 20/20 pass: /admin/estimates loads, seed estimate #1 shows 'Approved' badge + linked-project-1 button, TEST_ estimate creation via UI (Not sent badge), send-approval modal shows amber 'Email failed to send' warning (EXPECTED bad SMTP) with copy-approve-link/copy-reject-link + APPROVE/REJECT code URLs, badge -> 'Awaiting client response', public /estimate-approval/:id/:token page (fresh browser context, no login) renders estimate-approval-page with approval-amount ₹55,555 -> public-approve-button -> approval-done panel; revisit -> approval-error (single-use enforced via 410); public reject flow types 'Too expensive' -> approval-done, admin badge 'Rejected *' with title tooltip = 'Too expensive'; re-send after rejection -> badge 'Awaiting client response'; manual approve (window.confirm accepted) auto-opens project-form-modal with from-estimate-banner text 'These details were auto-filled from Estimate #22 (Civil Works). Please verify...' and pre-filled project-name-input + project-budget-input=77777, selecting client + project-form-submit -> navigate to /admin/projects/7, back on estimates row shows linked-project button and send/approve buttons hidden; manual approve + cancel of ProjectFormModal -> create-project-from-estimate button visible; manual reject via window.prompt: dismissing prompt aborts (badge stays 'Not sent'), providing 'Budget mismatch' -> badge 'Rejected *' with tooltip = 'Budget mismatch'. Email failure + copyable links is confirmed as graceful expected path (NOT a bug).
critical_code_review_comments: estimates.py — token check uses secrets.compare_digest (constant-time) — good. token_used flag is set BEFORE apply_decision inside public_estimate_decision, so any DB failure inside apply_decision leaves token consumed; consider wrapping in try/except with rollback, otherwise if apply_decision raises the token gets burned without state change. Non-blocking.

estimates.py send_for_approval — uses smtplib.SMTP_SSL with 20s timeout; the API call takes noticeable time when SMTP fails (test observed ~5-10s). Consider running email send in background (BackgroundTasks) so the frontend response is instant and email failures still surface via a follow-up ping or audit event.

estimates.py — email HTML has an incorrect drawing URL construction: it links to `${FRONTEND_URL}/api/uploads/{filename}` which only works if the ingress path prefixes /api on the frontend host (which it does here). Fine for this env but tighten if FRONTEND_URL changes.

estimates.py manual_decision — sets e.token_used = True after apply_decision (good — prevents further public link use once admin manually decides). But once approved via manual override, if user then wants to Re-send (which they can — send_for_approval regenerates token), the old public link becomes invalid: correct behavior confirmed by TestResend.

link-project restricted to Admin (require_roles('Admin')) — good; Accountant 403 verified. However there is no re-linking or un-linking endpoint, so a wrong project_id is permanent — consider adding an unlink/relink flow gated to Admin for future.

EstimateApprovalPage.jsx — public page reads action from query params but I did not verify it auto-opens reject-panel from ?action=reject; the Playwright test handled both branches (checks for panel presence, falls back to public-reject-button click). Non-blocking but worth verifying UX.

ProjectFormModal.jsx — from-estimate-banner + auto-open + auto-fill are wired correctly; onCreated callback navigates to project detail on success (verified navigation to /admin/projects/7). Good pattern.
SendForApprovalModal.jsx — URLs shown in <code> elements (truncated visually). Copy buttons work; consider showing a small toast on copy for feedback (may already exist).
seed_data_creation: Created via UI: TEST_Approval_<ts> (approved via public link), TEST_Reject_<ts> (rejected via public link, then re-sent), TEST_Manual_<ts> (manually approved + linked to new project #7), TEST_Cancel_<ts> (manually approved, project modal cancelled → create-project-from-estimate button available), TEST_ManualReject_<ts> (manually rejected via prompt with reason 'Budget mismatch'). Created via API (pytest): ~14 TEST_approval_* estimates covering token/RBAC scenarios and 1 new linked project (project_id from seed). Seed estimate #1 'Hillside Cottage' + linked project #6 still present.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Estimate approval workflow is production-ready. Public route /estimate-approval/:id/:token requires no auth. window.confirm/prompt used for manual override (register dialog handler with page.once('dialog', ...)). URLs from send-approval response live inside <code> elements in [data-testid='approval-sent-result'], not inputs. Backend send-approval takes ~5-10s due to synchronous SMTP timeout — consider background task refactor. iteration_22 introduced ~20 TEST_ estimate rows; a cleanup pass may be worthwhile before further UI tests.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. Email failure with copyable-link fallback is the expected graceful path per SMTP creds still being rejected by Google; verified UI shows amber warning + APPROVE/REJECT URLs and badge transitions to 'Awaiting client response'.
